annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅转发住房城乡建设部《关于进一步加强城市建筑垃圾治理的意见》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the State Council Forwarding the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development's Opinions on Further Strengthening Urban Construction Waste Management
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council); 住房城乡建设部
annotation.summary_en: State Council General Office notice (Guobanhan [2025] No. 57, 6 June 2025) forwarding the Housing Ministry's opinions on urban construction waste governance. It sets a 50% resource-utilisation target by 2027 and covers source reduction, transport supervision, disposal facilities, recycling and whole-process digital oversight. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Target of over 50% average construction waste recycling in prefecture-level cities by 2027
Classified treatment of construction waste and source-reduction duties on builders
Transport vehicle technical requirements, including BeiDou positioning, and a blacklist/exit mechanism
National information platform using IoT, satellite and big data with electronic manifests
Joint enforcement and local legislation; support for equipment R&D
